system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Namaste, can you help me? Perform these two different actions simultaneously: enam_get_arrival_data and enam_raise_grievance. Here are my details: my description is dummy_description_4974, my grievance_category is dummy_grievance_category_6870, my commodity is dummy_commodity_7241, my location is dummy_location_7081.

function.name: enam_get_arrival_data
function.description: Retrieves arrival quantities and demand trends for a commodity at a mandi. PUBLIC tool. Does NOT show prices — use enam_get_mandi_prices. Fails if mandi or commodity is unsupported.

function.name: enam_raise_grievance
function.description: Raises a grievance about eNAM data. Valid categories: 'incorrect_price', 'missing_mandi_data', 'delayed_update', 'wrong_location', 'commodity_not_found'. Requires session_token. Fails if category is invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after optional authentication. Required for preference and grievance tools.
